Pledges and holdings have no history and were unknown throughout. The tables hold companies listed today, and a revised filing is seen from the revision's date.

short_empty.empty_text: No stock passes every screen today. A breakout from a tight base, in a strong industry, with profit not falling, is uncommon: in the test about one list in four was empty. An empty list is the answer, not a fault.

short_empty.method: A stock is here when it spent 40 sessions inside a range 18% wide or tighter and then closed above it on at least twice its usual volume in the last five sessions, and is still above it. It must also pass five screens: above its 200-day average and in the stronger half of liquid stocks; six or more of nine chart conditions; its industry in the top half on money flow; no fall in profit last quarter; and results, if just out, not sold by the market. A serious adverse filing removes it. Picks are ordered on strength, chart, industry and profit growth together. The record beside the list is this rule replayed on NSE prices from 2017 to 2026: the list as it stood every fifth session, bought at the next open.
